The change refines, not relaxes, the matching contract: inside one strength tier a more literal selector wins (literal characters, plus 10,000 for an exact path), an exact path beats an equal glob, and equal literal specificity still reports Ambiguous. It applies in the main candidate path and the fallback path.

Shadowed top-strength candidates that matched a finding are recorded as used rather than unused, in both the unique-winner and ambiguity branches, so the unused-entry scan cannot emit a false Stale and prune --stale cannot delete a load-bearing entry; the ambiguity row's candidate_ids stay narrowed to the tied set.
The winning site uses tied_candidates.first() with let-else, so pregate's no-new guard reports no unreceipted panic.indexing entry and policy/allow.toml was not edited.
